body:
bk-2C-B Nighmare
To start off, I have a pretty extensive background with different substances including Marijuana, spice, dxm, alcohol, xanax, hydros, dilaudid, 4-fa, 4-mec, 25i, 25b, 25c, mxe, mdma, e, and so on. I started tripping when I was 16, after I got in contact with M. I had always been curious about what hallucinating would be like. So after some discussion with my best friend, T, we decided that we would embark on a new adventure that night, and both try a tab.
M dropped off the two tabs and I handed him the money, he told us to dry our gums out a little bit with a towl/ shirt and stick the tab on our gums and let it sit there for awhile. We both followed his instructions exactly, and within 45 minutes of having the tab in my mouth, I was cascaded by waves of euphoria and geometric visuals. It was an awesome experience, which was definitely worth repeating. This was my first experience with what I believe to be 25b, although I can't be completely certain.
Now, come one year later, and I had tripped a lot. By the time I was 17 I had tripped about 12 times at least, but had never had anything bad happen, other than hallucinating extremely hard on a couple occasions. I stop by my dealer's house to buy my regular bag of weed and he tells me that he also has a little something extra if I was interested. I asked him what it was, and he pulled out a baggie that was clearly mailed from a rc vendor. It had a label that said Bk-2cb 2gs, not for human consumption, yada yada. My dealer, D, told me that his friend had taken some and had not experienced much of anything. I decided to try it and gave him 10 dollars for a sample. He told me that nobody had tripped off it yet and he wanted me to tell him how I felt afterwards. I agreed, and he poured a small pile into my hand. I can't be sure of how much the dose was, but It was about the amount of one full capsule. I then just ate the powder straight, like I do with molly or beans, and it burned my throat pretty noticeably going down. I thought that was strange because I've eaten a lot of molly & never had anything burn.
After I ate it I stayed inside of D's house for about 5 or 10 more minutes and something really strange started happening. Within about 10 minutes of ingesting the powder, my skull started to feel a bit tingly, it's a hard sensation to describe. I thought that this was strange because I had JUST ingested the powder, but I shrugged it off and drove home.
[Erowid Note: 
Driving while intoxicated, tripping, or extremely sleep deprived is dangerous and irresponsible because it endangers other people.
Don't do it!
]
I drove all the way home, and was feeling fine, other than the persisting tingly feeling in my head. My boss and friend then called me and asked if I could bring him bud, I agreed and got back into my car and headed out. As I was driving to his house, I started noticing slight visuals and all around just a strange sensation. When I got to his house, I was still not tripping hard yet and sat down with him to smoke a bowl of the weed I was selling to him. This is where things start to get sketchy...
Halfway through the bowl, I notice visuals that resemble that of 25b, or 2C-B. It was at this point I started feeling a little strange and told my boss I was gonna head out and that I was tired. He said goodnight, and I walked out the door. This is where I clearly remember the pain starting. Right as I walked outside, my whole body began to have a stabbing pain as if someone was twisting a knife into me. The pain went from my right lung area, all the way down the backs of my legs. I instantly began to fear for my safety, and wished I had never taken this shit. I managed to drive all the way back to my house in this terrible, panicked, hallucinating position. Right when I pulled into my driveway, my roommate S was standing in the driveway staring straight at me. (I later came to figure out that he had driven up right before me, and seen me as he got out and waited for me to pull up.) But all I saw was him staring straight at me standing there as I pulled in. Right as I got out of the car, he knew that something wasn't right by the look on my face. He asked me if I was alright, and I told him that I think that I need to be taken to a hospital. By this point the pain in what felt like my right lung was extremely intense. Not to mention the unbearable visuals. I thought that I was about to die, and I was really scared. If S wouldn't have been there to talk me out of going to the hospital, I would have woken my dad up in the other room for sure and had him take me.
Long story short, the visuals persisted all night. I couldn't sleep and I was in a tremendous amount of pain in my stomach and legs.

The next day when I walked around, my legs felt like I have jogged 2 miles, they were very sore, and I felt extremely dazed. I feel very lucky to have survived this un-researched chemical, and the reason I wrote this report is so people thinking about trying it should definitely do so with caution. I have done many substances, but never have had severe side effects like from this one.
